description: This source file contains a set of unit tests for the DurableDictionary class, which implements a persistent, journaled dictionary using Orleans' infrastructure. The tests verify basic operations, persistence, handling of complex key and value types, clear operation, enumeration, and recovery capabilities of the DurableDictionary within the Orleans system.

classes.name: DurableDictionaryTests
classes.description: A test class containing various unit tests to validate the functionality and persistence features of the DurableDictionary class in Orleans.

classes.name: TestKey
classes.description: A record type used as a complex key in some of the dictionary tests, with serialization attributes to support Orleans serialization.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_BasicOperations_Test
methods.description: Tests basic add, update, remove, and access operations of the durable dictionary.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_Persistence_Test
methods.description: Verifies that the dictionary's state is correctly persisted and can be recovered after restart.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_ComplexKeys_Test
methods.description: Checks handling of complex user-defined key types within the dictionary.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_ComplexValues_Test
methods.description: Checks handling of complex user-defined value types, including updating nested objects.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_Clear_Test
methods.description: Verifies that the Clear operation removes all items and persists this change.

methods.name: DurableDictionary_Enumeration_Test
methods.description: Tests enumeration, keys, and values iteration over the dictionary.
